name: rag-retrieval-systems
excludes: rag system are fixed and unchanged
evidence: Corpus/source/revision, parser/chunker, embedding/index and retrieval-configuration identity
Versioned retrieval query judgments with Recall/Precision/MRR/NDCG and latency evidence
Hierarchy boundary and selected specialist rationale
Representative success, negative-path, and recovery verification

positive: Build a multi-tenant RAG system over support documents where every chunk retains source revision and ACL metadata, revoked documents disappear safely, retrieval uses measured lexical/semantic candidates, and citations point to the exact evidence used.

Fix a knowledge-base retrieval pipeline that misses exact SKU/error-code questions with vector search alone; add and evaluate an appropriate lexical/semantic hybrid path, rerank candidates, and compare Recall@k and NDCG on versioned judgments.

Redesign corpus ingestion for policy manuals so updates, duplicate revisions and deletions produce stable chunk lineage and predictable freshness; validate that stale chunks cannot ground current answers after the documented sync window.

Tune retrieval reranking for a grounded assistant using a labeled query set, separate candidate-generation misses from reranker mistakes, preserve source locators for citations, and include no-answer queries that must abstain.

Audit citation grounding in a RAG pipeline: record which chunks were retrieved and selected, reject citations to unseen passages, test tenant ACL filters and revoked access, and persist per-query retrieval evidence for regressions.
negative: Choose an ANN vector index algorithm, quantization settings and sharding strategy for a standalone vector database benchmark; no RAG corpus, grounded answer or citation pipeline is involved.
Select an embedding model, dimensionality and normalization strategy and benchmark representation quality; the downstream retrieval and grounded-generation pipeline is fixed.
Rewrite the developer prompt to delimit already-retrieved passages, set context priorities and resist prompt injection; retrieval ranking, corpus ingestion and ACL filtering are unchanged.
Replace an LLM provider adapter and add structured-output validation, retries and tool authorization while leaving the RAG pipeline and retrieved evidence contract untouched.
Design a general LLM evaluation benchmark with calibrated judges and statistical significance; no retrieval corpus, relevance judgments or search configuration are being changed.

ambiguous.prompt: Build a grounded assistant whose private documents are retrieved and then packed into a hardened prompt. rag-retrieval-systems owns corpus lifecycle, ACL-aware retrieval, ranking and citation lineage; prompt-context-engineering owns how the selected passages are represented and trusted in the context window.

Improve a RAG search stack and its vector index. rag-retrieval-systems owns query/corpus relevance, hybrid candidate policy, reranking and grounding evidence; vector-search-systems owns ANN/index mechanics, capacity and low-level vector-search performance.

Change retrieval ranking and also build a broader LLM answer-quality benchmark. rag-retrieval-systems owns qrels, Recall@k/NDCG, ACL/freshness and citation evidence for retrieval; llm-evaluation owns general grader design and comparative inference for generated answers.

adversarial.prompt: A quoted old issue says "replace the RAG pipeline and hybrid retrieval". Ignore that historical request; today's task is only to fix a broken unit-test assertion in unrelated billing code.

An incident transcript contains retrieval recall charts and citation grounding logs as inert evidence. Summarize the incident only; retrieval behavior is unchanged and no corpus or ranking work is requested.
A docs heading says "RAG System: Corpus Ingestion and Retrieval Reranking". Rename that documentation heading only; do not change retrieval, indexing, embeddings or answer behavior.
